Description de l'entreprise
Cream is an Information Technology consulting firm with a proven experience in combining Innovation Delivery, Motivating Culture and Continuous Improvement - what we call Enterprise Agility.
We deliver our services to industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, Pharmaceutical & Transport.
Cream is developing rapidly his network of consultants especially thanks to his growing portfolio of clients. For that reason, we are looking to recruit new consultants to strengthen our teams.
Our objective is to assemble the best talents so as to build multidisciplinary teams supported by the expertise of our Practices.
Services:
> Information System
> Infrastructure
> Big Data/ Businnes Intelligence
> Project Management
> Agile
> Digitalization
> Product
> Compliance
Description de la fonction
What is Cream all about ?
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...
But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.
The Cream recipe
- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects
Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :
Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements
Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT
Analyze the impact due to required evolutions
Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations
Design and document the to-be process
Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing
Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders
Change management and deployment
Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients
What do we expect from our consultant ?
You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis
You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables
You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset
An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset
A knowledge of Business Process Modeling (ARIS, Visio, Camounda, UML, ...)
Why should you taste the lime flavor ?
A strong learning environment: tribes, training budget
Career follow-up with dedicated Business Managers and an associate plan
Attractive benefits package (mobility plan, meal vouchers, insurances,...)
Hybrid working model: client working, home working & Cream working
Strong Csr commitments, with recognized labels in environmental responsibility and diversity & inclusion.
A consulting company of around 200 Creamers, located in the center of Brussels
Our recruitment process is clear and structured, with three steps and feedback throughout.
Cream Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. If you need any specific accommodation to fully participate in the recruitment process or the interview, please let us know.
Think this role is a match? Apply and let's talk, or explore our other opportunities at Cream.
